name: Purple Garden Relationship Knowledge Base (PG-RKB) & Humor Intelligence Library (PG-HKB)

sources.name: Open English WordNet (OEWN)
sources.attributionText: Open English WordNet (John P. McCrae, Michael Wayne Goodman, Francis Bond, et al.). Derived from Princeton WordNet.
sources.notes: Version-pinned 2025 JSON release. Machine-readable WordNet synsets, word senses, definitions, hypernyms, hyponyms, and domain classifications.

sources.name: Princeton WordNet
sources.attributionText: WordNet Release 3.1. Copyright 2011 by Princeton University. All rights reserved.
sources.notes: Upstream foundational lexical database. Fully covered by and merged into Open English WordNet 2025.

sources.name: Wikidata Structured Entity Knowledge
sources.version: Live SPARQL Endpoint / Entity JSON Exports (2026-11)
sources.attributionText: Wikidata contributors. CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication.
sources.notes: Selective extraction for everyday household items, cookware, ingredients, beverages, physical activities, and personal belongings.

sources.name: VerbNet (University of Colorado Boulder)
sources.attributionText: VerbNet. University of Colorado Boulder. CLEAR Group (Martha Palmer et al.).
sources.notes: Thematic roles, selectional restrictions, syntactic frames, and semantic predicates for action and behavioral verbs across 8 core classes.

sources.name: Tatoeba Corpus
sources.attributionText: Tatoeba.org contributors. Released under CC BY 2.0 FR / CC0.
sources.notes: Real conversational English phrases, everyday informal expressions, and natural syntactic variations sampled across domestic keywords.

sources.name: Published Relationship Interaction Research
sources.attributionText: Synthesized from public empirical findings on marital interaction dynamics (Gottman, Christensen, Markman, Karney & Bradbury).
sources.notes: Factual classification of couple recurring interaction dynamics (demand-withdraw, chore division, conversational bids, bedtime rhythms).

sources.name: Purple Garden Original Knowledge & Humor Taxonomy
sources.attributionText: Copyright 2026 Purple Garden Project. All rights reserved.
sources.notes: Original couple-centric situation models, contrast models, 36 humor mechanisms, 34 metaphor families, 324 humor constructions, and tone profiles.

sources.name: Berkeley FrameNet (ICSI)
sources.licenseIdentifier: Custom ICSI Commercial License / Academic Free
sources.notes: Commercial license agreement & fee required for redistributable software. Deferred from direct machine import. Semantic frame structures are independently formulated for Purple Garden.

sources.name: ConceptNet 5
sources.notes: Share-Alike clause (CC BY-SA 4.0) imposes viral copyleft obligations on derived distributable code/data. Deferred from distribution.

sources.name: SemEval-2017 Task 7 (Puns & Wordplay)
sources.notes: Non-commercial restriction (NC). Used for theoretical research on pun/incongruity mechanisms only; dataset text excluded.

sources.name: SemEval-2021 Task 7 (HaHackathon Humor & Offense)
sources.notes: Twitter TOS and non-commercial academic contest terms. Research reference only for humor rating & offense filtering theory.
